profile.subtitleJa: エジプト王がエルヤキムをユダの王とし、その名をエホヤキムに改めたと記されます。
profile.summaryJa: 歴代誌下36:4は、エジプト王がエルヤキムをユダとエルサレムの王にし、名をエホヤキムに変えたと伝えます。

facts.textJa: この節では、エホヤキムが主なる神の目に悪とされること、在位期間が11年だったことが述べられます。
記事はエホヤキムの行いに言及し、息子エホヤキンが後を継いだと記します。

profile.historicalRoleJa: エジプト王がエルヤキムをユダの王とし、その名をエホヤキムに改めたと記されます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in the LORD his God’s sight.

Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
